entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie, I need to process a return for a VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I received it on January 2nd.
Okay, thank you. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse. So, just to understand the situation fully, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The band works fine, it just doesn't really fit my lifestyle. Now, I know it's been 18 days, but I did try to return this about a week and a half ago, on the 11th.
I see. What happened when you tried to process the return online?

There was a pretty bad **website error**. It looked like the whole returns **system** was **down**. I got all the way to the end, but I **couldn't print** the label. I even took a **screenshot** of the error page just in case.

Thank you for explaining that, and I do apologize for the trouble. I'm checking our system logs now... and yes, I can confirm we had a known outage with our returns portal on that date. I'm sorry you were impacted by that. Let me just pull up the return policy for this item.
Okay, I have it here. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. So I'm well within the window then.

Yes, absolutely. Since you received it on January 2nd, you are well within the 90-day timeframe. I've just processed the return authorization for you. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file.

Perfect, that's what I needed. I appreciate you taking care of that. Just as a thought, since I had to go through the extra hassle of calling in because of the website issue, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase?

That's a reasonable question. Unfortunately, since we're providing a full refund for the item, my system doesn't allow me to issue an additional credit or discount. But I have placed a note on your account about the inconvenience you experienced with the portal outage.
Understood. That's fair. The full refund is the main thing. Thanks for your help today, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Just drop the package off with the label, and your refund will be issued 3-5 business days after we receive it. Have a great rest of your day!
